g.text: O7 · CUDA GRAPHS FOR LIVE QUERIES
bench.py sends one query per encode() call. Small kernels are launch-bound, so each bucket (32/64/128 tok) is captured once.
Submitted: the 32-token graph runs the FP32 copy (P2) → service 3.71 ms (graph) vs 4.05 ms (eager).
